about: The muscles of the shoulder and the upper arm: the deltoid over the shoulder, the four rotator cuff muscles on the shoulder blade, and the biceps and triceps of the upper arm, drawn against the shoulder blade and the humerus of the shoulder and arm bone atlas. The drives are the whole-body ones the engine has: muscle tone, exertion, shivering and a seizure. Arm movement, the forearm and force are not simulated. The figure's arm ends at the elbow, so the muscles do too.

GH14.label: Hall JE, Hall ME. Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology, 14th ed. Elsevier, 2021.

GRAYS42.label: Standring S (ed). Gray's Anatomy: The Anatomical Basis of Clinical Practice, 42nd ed. Elsevier, 2020.

parts.label: Deltoid
parts.summary: The rounded muscle that caps the shoulder
parts.function: The deltoid covers the shoulder joint and runs from the clavicle and the shoulder blade to the humerus. It lifts the arm away from the side.

drives.note: Exertion is the fraction of aerobic capacity in use; the textbook says working skeletal muscle takes most of the extra blood flow and oxygen of exercise, so a muscle used in effort rises with it. The weight is a display scale and not a muscle force.
Shivering is rhythmic contraction of skeletal muscle that makes heat; the textbook describes it as a whole-body muscle response, so this muscle rises with it. The weight is a display scale.
Raised skeletal muscle tone (rigidity) is a rise in the tone of the muscles of the body, so a muscle of this group tightens with it. The weight is a display scale.
Lost skeletal muscle tone (paralysis) lowers the tone of the muscles of the body, so this muscle goes slack. The weight is a display scale.

parts.label: Rotator Cuff
parts.summary: Supraspinatus, infraspinatus, teres minor and subscapularis
parts.function: These four muscles run from the shoulder blade to the head of the humerus and hold the ball in its socket while the arm moves.

parts.label: Biceps Brachii
parts.summary: The muscle on the front of the upper arm
parts.function: The biceps runs from the shoulder blade to the radius and bends the elbow and turns the forearm.

parts.label: Triceps Brachii
parts.summary: The muscle on the back of the upper arm
parts.function: The triceps runs from the shoulder blade and the back of the humerus to the ulna and straightens the elbow.
